page.overview:
Who is Lasswell?

Lasswell is a major character in Final Fantasy Brave Exvius, who will also appear in the upcoming Final Fantasy Resonance.

A renowned knight from the Kingdom of Grandshelt, he is Rain's childhood friend and adopted brother and treats his adoptive father, Raegen, with great respect. Together, he and Rain are granted the power of visions by the mysterious Fina so that they can save their world, Lapis.

Lasswell is the deuteragonist of season one, the focus character of season two, and remains relevant in later seasons, albeit with less emphasis.

He wields the sword Purple Lightning, which is featured in the game's logo, along with Rain's Crimson Saber and Fina herself. He wields both for a majority of season two, before returning to his signature weapon only.
